existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `Location` has hard local breaking changes in contact, physical form, and availability modeling. The main migration concerns are raw element removals/renames, the `Availability` datatype remodel, and terminology drift in `Location.type`. The largest uncertainty is the absence of official ConceptMaps and complete terminology expansions for service/location role mappings.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Most affected R4 instances can be migrated, but not by pass-through validation. Implementers should build explicit transforms for `telecom` to `contact.telecom`, `physicalType` to `form`, `hoursOfOperation[*]` to one `Availability.availableTime[*]`, and `availabilityExceptions` to `notAvailableTime.description` where appropriate. R6-to-R4 downgrade needs extensions or lossy omission for `virtualService`, contact purpose/name/address/organization/period, availability periods, geospatial codes, and characteristics.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural differences because they are directly present in the R4 and R6 StructureDefinition snapshots/differentials. Confidence is medium for exact semantic and terminology migration because official diffs, ConceptMaps, narrative rationale, and terminology-server expansions were not available. Inherited base-artifact changes were intentionally excluded.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Location keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 4 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 53/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Location.telecom was replaced by structured Location.contact
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing `Location.telecom` fail strict R6 validation unless transformed; generated API paths also change and richer R6 contacts create R6-to-R4 loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Location.physicalType was renamed to Location.form
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with `Location.physicalType` are rejected by strict R6 validation, and generated code/FHIRPath references to the old property break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Location.hoursOfOperation changed from repeated backbone entries to a single Availability datatype
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with the old backbone array and child names do not match the R6 `Availability` shape; generated API classes and R6-to-R4 conversion of richer exception data also change.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Location.availabilityExceptions was removed and only partially maps to Availability.notAvailableTime
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing `availabilityExceptions` use a removed top-level element; R6-to-R4 conversion of multiple dated exception periods can be lossy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Location.type changed meaning and value set from location role/function to service type
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: old data is usually still syntactically valid, but the same path now carries a different business meaning and validation/code-generation policies may materialize a different code set.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 added Location.code and Location.characteristic classification elements without R4 core targets
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 instances using these optional additions have no lossless R4 core target, but there is no forward R4-to-R6 validation or API break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 added Location.virtualService with no R4 core equivalent
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 instances using the new optional element cannot be represented losslessly in R4 core, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Location.description type changed from string to markdown
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: metadata/tooling: the primitive label and rendering expectations change, but old string-valued JSON remains a string-valued element in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
